tldr: An inquiry found that government failings, including a lack of PPE and improper patient discharges, contributed to the rapid spread of Covid in care homes.
Salesforce announced a $5.66 billion acquisition of Braze, causing Braze's stock to surge significantly.
Pending home sales in the U.S. fell to a 25-year low in September, as buyers reacted to elevated mortgage rates.

market.why: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite closed higher, driven by positive sentiment in the tech sector following Salesforce's $5.66 billion acquisition of Braze and ongoing investment interest in AI-related ventures, including potential new data center deals and a new AI manufacturing startup.

yield_10y.why: The articles do not directly state reasons for the daily increase in the 10-year Treasury yield.

vix.why: The VIX declined, suggesting a reduction in anticipated market volatility. This shift could be linked to hopes for diplomatic progress in the Middle East, which contributed to a fall in oil prices, and investor focus shifting towards corporate earnings.

watchlist.read: Mid-range - 7% of the way up its 1-month band.

mortgage.why: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate remained unchanged at 7.4% in the latest weekly survey released on October 15, 2026. This rate generally tracks the direction of the 10-year Treasury yield over recent days. High mortgage rates continue to impact the housing market, contributing to pending home sales falling to a 25-year low and builders cutting prices as buyer traffic decreased to a 14-year low.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: This document contains final regulations regarding the deduction for certain taxpayers for an amount up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.
policy_upcoming.effect: You can deduct up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_calendar.label: ACA marketplace open enrollment opens — expected early November
policy_calendar.note: healthcare.gov has opened enrollment on November 1 each year, and currently publishes December 15 as the deadline for coverage starting January 1. The window is set by federal rule and has been changed by rulemaking before.

policy_calendar.label: IRS 401(k) and IRA contribution limits for next year — expected late October or early November
policy_calendar.note: The annual cost-of-living adjustment notice, historically released within a week or two of the bracket figures. It sets how much can go into a 401(k) and an IRA next year.

policy_calendar.label: IRS tax brackets and the married-filing-jointly standard deduction for next year — expected late October or early November
policy_calendar.note: Published as an annual inflation-adjustment revenue procedure; recent releases landed between mid-October and mid-November. These are the bracket thresholds and the standard deduction the next return is filed against.

tech.summary: Adobe Lightroom mobile can now use generative AI to automatically open closed eyes in photos with a single tap, adding a new editing capability for users.
An open-source Rust AI gateway called Respan has been launched, featuring a plugin-based architecture that allows for integration with various AI providers, protocols, and modalities.
Research has demonstrated that fabricated statistics published online can be easily cited by large language models, raising concerns about the integrity of information propagated by AI.

world.summary: Ukrainian President Zelensky is holding talks with US envoys and Nordic leaders in Oslo amid ongoing discussions about international support and intelligence sharing.
France announced it will deploy military forces to reinforce police during anticipated weekend protests across the country.
The eastern Libyan parliament has approved a 2019 maritime deal with Turkey, officially ending a boycott of the agreement that began in 2020.

In Sudan, army drones reportedly struck mourners and a fuel market, resulting in over 200 deaths, while in Yemen, local authorities state that a Houthi missile strike killed 73 security recruits at a training camp.

us.summary: A federal judge chastised the Trump administration for continuing with the overhaul of a historic public golf course in Washington D.C., including the removal of hundreds of trees, despite a prior court order.
In states with their own paid family leave programs, men are now filing the majority of claims to bond with new children, indicating a shift in usage patterns for parental benefits.

In North Carolina, five police officers resigned and one was suspended following the discovery of alleged racist text messages during an investigation into the misuse of a camera system, prompting a review of arrest records.

science.summary: A Covid inquiry found that government failures, including inadequate provision of PPE and problematic patient discharges from hospitals, allowed the virus to spread extensively in care homes.
A late-stage analysis revealed that Novo's experimental obesity drug, CagriSema, demonstrated a 25% weight loss in women, potentially surpassing the efficacy of current treatments like Wegovy.
